records.label: Protected focus window
records.description: Reduce interruption during a defined high-demand production or verification block.

records.label: Notification and interruption control
records.description: Suppress or batch non-critical prompts while the active task model must remain stable.

records.label: Visible task-state record
records.description: Externalise the current goal, stage, unresolved issues and next action to support re-entry.

records.label: Source–claim ledger
records.description: Keep each claim linked to its source, population, context and evidential status.

records.label: Source–claim matrix
records.description: Compare sources and claims systematically during synthesis.

records.label: Separate drafting and verification stages
records.description: Prevent fluent production from silently substituting for independent checking.

records.label: Explicit release checkpoint
records.description: Define the evidence and role requirements for releasing or acting on an output.

records.label: Structured handoff
records.description: Transfer goal, state, sources, unresolved issues, decisions and next actions in a standard form.

records.label: Re-entry cue
records.description: Provide a concise reconstruction prompt after interruption, delay or handoff.

records.label: Decision-sufficiency gate
records.description: Ask whether further information would materially change the action, safety or interpretation.

records.label: Disconfirmation checkpoint
records.description: Require one serious alternative or failure test before consequential closure.

records.label: Reduce concurrent workload
records.description: Reduce active cases, tasks or streams when system demand exceeds a workable range.

records.label: Clarify decision rights
records.description: Specify who decides, who reviews and when escalation is required.
